name: Air-Fryer Millet Croquettes
ingredients: ½ cup cooked foxtail millet (from ¼ cup dry)
½ cup grated carrot and zucchini, squeezed dry
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each cumin and garam masala
steps: Mix the millet, chickpeas, vegetables, besan, chilli, ginger, spices and salt into a firm mixture.
Shape into 8 croquettes and chill for 15 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C. Brush the croquettes lightly with oil.
Cook for 14–16 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.
note: A gluten-free alternative to potato croquettes with more fibre.
